description.value: The tracking module embeds a specific magical signature on wounds inflicted by the weapon. You can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Track] a target damaged by your weapon, substituting an Arcana ([[/act track skill=arcana]]), Nature ([[/act track skill=nature]]), Occultism ([[/act track skill=occultism]]), or Religion ([[/act track skill=religion]]) check for the Survival check. Much like Tracking with Survival, this must take place somewhere the target has been and follow the trail; it doesn't allow anyone to find the target from a distance. The magical signature wears off after 1 week.
